card.name: Stem, rod and root in D&C 113
card.desc: D&C 113 — Section 113 identifies the stem of Jesse as Christ and describes the rod and the root as servants or descendants with particular roles, without giving their personal names. No unnamed servant is assigned to a particular person here.

card.name: Isaiah 29 and the Book of Mormon (JST introduction)
card.desc: Old Testament — The editorial introduction to the Joseph Smith Translation of Isaiah 29 relates the chapter’s message to the Book of Mormon. It is an editorial introduction, not wording added to the KJV verses, and it creates no Ariel site in the Americas.
